title: Built environment from the ancient Bali: The Balinese heritage for sustainable water management
lineage: Modern scholarly reading of an inscription, not an independently inspected inscription. Different institutional chronologies give slightly different conversions; use a broad late-tenth-century bound.

passages.locator: Section 3, Manukaya inscription and Tirta Empul paragraph
passages.note: Reports a tenth-century dam repair and irrigation use at the spring, dating the inscription to 960; later subaks are described separately.
